entities.definition: Configuration 1 reference alpha fields, log, metric values and tolerances. This is simulation-regression evidence, not an experimental observation.
entities.label: Committed simulation baseline

entities.definition: The diagram calls this testcase.foam; the repository template is named case2D.foam. It opens the field data in compatible software.
entities.label: OpenFOAM case file

entities.definition: Experimental images in the primary process model of Validation.drawio. This occurrence retains its own identity and does not establish an executed experiment.
entities.label: Experimental images

entities.definition: Experimental metrics in the primary process model of Validation.drawio. This occurrence retains its own identity and does not establish an executed experiment.
entities.label: Experimental metrics

entities.definition: A newly computed plot compares the recorded scalar outcomes for the three configurations. Six original saved images show finger-count curves and final masks; their plotted trajectories are not recovered as numeric data.
entities.label: Recorded outcome comparison

entities.definition: A new comparison of rounded recorded metrics with the committed baseline and tolerances. It reproduces the recorded pass, fail and skip pattern without running a solver; sensitivity configurations are compared with the configuration 1 reference.
entities.label: Recomputed recorded-data checks

entities.definition: The mesh is generated from a parameter configuration and supplied to the solver; generated mesh archives are not committed evidence.
entities.label: Generated mesh

entities.definition: The three rounded metric rows transcribed by code from the committed walkthrough. Phase fraction, continuity error and wall time remain missing for all three configurations; the baseline is never used to fill these gaps.
entities.label: Recorded metrics table

entities.definition: Historical simulation frame at approximately 10 s, according to the extraction script. The original AVI is not included in this checkout.
entities.label: Reference simulation image

entities.definition: Saved notebook: configuration 1 has 4 passes and 3 skips. Configuration 2 has 2 failures; configuration 3 has 1 failure against the configuration 1 baseline. Changed configurations are sensitivity cases.
entities.label: Saved regression results

entities.definition: Jinja2 templates bind parameter JSON to OpenFOAM dictionaries.
entities.label: Rendered OpenFOAM case

entities.definition: A saved notebook inspects the local m4i-augmented package. The existing writer describes one run as m4i:Method and uses schema:PropertyValue; this atlas does not silently rewrite those source claims.
entities.label: RO-Crate package

entities.definition: SPARQL examples explain how an uploaded research object could be queried. The saved ROHub notebook is unexecuted and is not evidence of publication.
entities.label: ROHub query guide

entities.definition: Historic run documented in the notebook. Three log-derived metrics are missing; configuration 1 passes the available baseline checks, while changed configurations differ from that reference.
entities.label: Saved three-configuration run

entities.definition: Time-resolved solver fields are documented in saved notebook outputs; committed baseline alpha.air fields are also available.
entities.label: Simulation field time series

entities.definition: The saved walkthrough embeds Cartesian figures and tip overlays for three configurations.
entities.label: Simulation images

entities.definition: Seven scalar metric keys and a finger-count time series are produced. Three log-derived metrics are missing in the saved run.
entities.label: Simulation metrics

entities.definition: n_fingers_over_time maps saved simulation times to field-based fingertip counts. Curves for all three configurations are embedded in the saved notebook.
entities.label: Finger count over time

entities.definition: Rendered transportProperties binds air/soap density and viscosity, surface tension, and gap width.
entities.label: transportProperties

entities.definition: Expected validation output; no experimentally grounded relative-error values are supplied.
entities.label: Validation metrics
